tools.name: purchase_report_data_credits
tools.description: Buys additional data-query credits for the analytics workspace by charging the company card on file. Returns the charge ID and the new credit balance.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: ID of the analytics workspace receiving the credits

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

PACK_PRICE_CENTS = 2500
PACK_CREDITS = 1000


@dataclass
class CreditPurchaseResult:
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    credits_added: int
    status: str


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_report_data_credits(workspace_id: str, credit_packs: int) -> dict:
    if credit_packs < 1 or credit_packs > 50:
        raise ValueError("credit_packs must be between 1 and 50")
    amount = PACK_PRICE_CENTS * credit_packs
    customer_id = f"cus_ws_{workspace_id}"
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "packs": credit_packs},
    )
    result = CreditPurchaseResult(
        charge_id=intent.id,
        amount_cents=amount,
        credits_added=PACK_CREDITS * credit_packs,
        status=intent.status,
    )
    return result.__dict__

tools.name: purge_expired_report_snapshots
tools.description: Permanently deletes report snapshot records older than the given number of days from the reports database, along with their exported files on disk. Snapshots marked as pinned are kept.

params.name: database_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite reports database

params.name: snapshot_directory
params.description: Directory holding the exported snapshot files

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Delete snapshots created more than this many days ago

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def purge_expired_report_snapshots(database_path: str, snapshot_directory: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    if older_than_days < 1:
        raise ValueError("older_than_days must be at least 1")

    cutoff_timestamp_iso_string = (
        datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)
    ).isoformat()
    snapshot_directory_path = Path(snapshot_directory).resolve()

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(database_path)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT id, file_name FROM report_snapshots "
            "WHERE created_at < ? AND pinned = 0",
            (cutoff_timestamp_iso_string,),
        )
        expired_snapshot_rows = database_cursor.fetchall()

        number_of_files_deleted = 0
        number_of_files_missing = 0
        identifiers_of_deleted_snapshots = []

        for snapshot_identifier, snapshot_file_name in expired_snapshot_rows:
            snapshot_file_path = (snapshot_directory_path / snapshot_file_name).resolve()
            if snapshot_directory_path not in snapshot_file_path.parents:
                continue
            if snapshot_file_path.exists():
                snapshot_file_path.unlink()
                number_of_files_deleted += 1
            else:
                number_of_files_missing += 1
            identifiers_of_deleted_snapshots.append(snapshot_identifier)

        database_cursor.executemany(
            "DELETE FROM report_snapshots WHERE id = ?",
            [(identifier,) for identifier in identifiers_of_deleted_snapshots],
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    return {
        "snapshots_deleted": len(identifiers_of_deleted_snapshots),
        "files_deleted": number_of_files_deleted,
        "files_missing": number_of_files_missing,
    }

tools.name: email_report_pdf
tools.description: Emails a generated report PDF as an attachment to a list of recipients using the company SMTP server.

params.name: pdf_path
params.description: Path to the PDF report file

params.name: recipients
params.description: Email addresses to send the report to

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.internal.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SENDER = os.environ.get("REPORT_SENDER", "reports@example.com")


def email_report_pdf(pdf_path: str, recipients: list, subject: str) -> dict:
    p = Path(pdf_path)
    if not p.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(pdf_path)
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(recipients)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content("Please find the attached analytics report.")
    msg.add_attachment(
        p.read_bytes(),
        maintype="application",
        subtype="pdf",
        filename=p.name,
    )
    s = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT)
    try:
        s.starttls()
        s.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        s.send_message(msg)
    finally:
        s.quit()
    return {"sent_to": len(recipients), "file": p.name}
